title: AI for Codebase Understanding and Documentation
objectives: Use AI to navigate large codebases and generate comprehensive documentation.
theory_markdown: AI can analyse codebases and answer questions about architecture, data flow, and dependencies. It can generate README files, API documentation, architecture diagrams (Mermaid), and onboarding guides.

code_walkthrough.code:
# Generated README.md structure

## Project Name
Brief description

## Architecture
code_walkthrough.explanation: AI-generated Mermaid diagrams visualise architecture. Endpoint tables provide quick API reference. Onboarding guides reduce time-to-productivity for new developers.

ai_tool_spotlight.description: Use **Mermaid Live Editor** (free) to render diagrams. Use **OpenCode** to analyse codebase architecture: `opencode ask "Explain the data flow from HTTP request to database"`
